subject: Handoff: CareVantage implementation & kickoff planning
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@carevantage.com>, Tom Rhee <tom.rhee@carevantage.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-01T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Handoff: CareVantage implementation & kickoff planning

Hi Emma / Tom —

Thanks again for the productive conversations last week. We are excited to get CareVantage live on Redwood. This thread is the formal sales-to-CS handoff and contains the immediate next steps so we can lock a kickoff date. Below is a short summary of the deal and expectations: 

- Scope: CC: realtime chat summarization + clinical note generation for ambulatory clinics (approx 1.2M tokens/month).
- Start date target: Week of Nov 15 (customer requested).
- Initial model: rdx-gpt-medium (quantized) with prefix caching enabled; we will iterate if quality/regression calls for it.
- SLA: 99.5% uptime target for production routes; higher-tier support available per contract.
- Contract status: SOW v1 attached; DocuSign routing in progress (Procurement: procurement@carevantage.com).

Attachments: CareVantage_SOW_v1.docx, CV_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx

Action items for CS/Implementation: 
1) Confirm kickoff availability (2-hour technical + ops orientation) — propose Nov 16 or Nov 18 (morning PT).
2) Collect technical contacts and VPC/network contacts for private deployment (if needed).
3) Review SOW assumptions and flag any outstanding questions before DocuSign.

Customer contacts: Emma Liu (Product Lead) & Tom Rhee (IT / Procurement).

Assigned CS owner (proposed): Vivek Kulkarni (implementation lead). Vivek — can you pick this up and suggest a kickoff time? Rishi — FYI for coverage and onboarding QA.

Thanks — I’ll leave the scheduling to you all.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

----
From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@carevantage.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Rhee <tom.rhee@carevantage.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: CareVantage implementation & kickoff planning

Thanks Soojin — really appreciate the clear summary. Nov 16 (morning PT) works best for us — we can do 9am PT.

A few notes from our side: 
- Procurement: Tom is the primary contact; we are ready to sign once the final SOW has the deployment timeline and the data retention clause clarified (we attached our standard clause in an earlier email).
- Data: initial pilot will use de-identified clinical notes; full PHI flows will be discussed post-pilot and will require additional security review.
- Network: We’ll confirm whether this will be hosted in our VPC or on Redwood hosted instances — I expect to know by EOD Nov 6.

Please include the kickoff invite and agenda.

—Emma
Emma Liu
Product Lead | CareVantage
emma.liu@carevantage.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-02T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Handoff: CareVantage implementation & kickoff planning (internal notes)

Internal notes — Vivek / Soojin: 

Thanks for the summary. A few internal items I want to capture before kickoff: 

- Risk: PHI flows are currently unknown. If they decide to send PHI we need to confirm Private deployment + KMS integration and add 3-week buffer for security review.
- Billing/limits: Sales committed to 1.2M tokens/month at tier-2 pricing; confirm committed throughput for first 30 days to size Dedicated pool if needed.
- Onboarding owner: Vivek will lead technical kickoff and implementation; I will cover post-go-live QA and SLO checks.
- Quality gate: Establish initial evaluation prompt set (R1) tied to SLOs; we should have eval curations by Day 7 post-kickoff.

Vivek — actionables for pre-kickoff: pull the onboarding checklist into the internal runbook, confirm prep tasks (API keys, network test plan, sample de-identified dataset), and propose a kickoff agenda.

I’ll also coordinate a quick internal sync with Product Reliability if PHI is confirmed.

Rishi
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@carevantage.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-02T11:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: CareVantage implementation & kickoff planning

Hi Emma — thanks for confirming availability. I’ve scheduled a 2-hour kickoff on Nov 16 at 9:00 AM PT and sent a calendar invite (please accept). Meeting link and agenda attached; agenda includes: 

1) Introductions + success criteria (15m)
2) Architecture overview and data flows (30m)
3) Network & security requirements (30m)
4) Pilot scoping and timeline (20m)
5) Next steps & owners (25m)

Attachments: Kickoff_Agenda.pdf

Pre-kickoff asks: 
- Emma/Tom: please share the network contact and the sample de-identified data slice (S3 link) prior to the call.
- Procurement: please confirm whether we should add the standard data retention clause shown in SOW v1 or use CareVantage language.

I’ll own the technical runbook and will share the internal checklist link after the meeting.

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>

Perfect — thanks everyone. Final coordination notes and owner assignment:
